heroHeadline: Anti-ICE Protests Erupt in New York After Man Shot Near Child
heroSubtitle: Demonstrators took to the streets in New York City linking a shooting incident — where a man was shot while in a car with his child — to the heightened climate of fear created by aggressive ICE enforcement operations.
